Metadata.title: OFM 2027 — Francophone Mathematical Olympiad · Dakar
Metadata.description: The 2027 Francophone Mathematical Olympiad brings together in Dakar the best young mathematicians of the French-speaking world, around exams designed by an international scientific committee. Organised by Terangamath.

Hero.title: The Francophone Mathematical Olympiad
Hero.lead: In 2027, Dakar welcomes the best young mathematicians of the French-speaking world, gathered around exams designed by an international scientific committee.

Event.title: The event, at a glance
Event.lead: An edition organised by Terangamath, in the heart of Dakar.

Categories.title: Two categories, one standard
Categories.lead: The Olympiad brings together middle and high school students around exams suited to their level, with the same scientific rigour.
Categories.juniorNote: Geometry, combinatorics, number theory and algebra problems suited to middle school.
Categories.seniorNote: Demanding problems, in the tradition of the international mathematical olympiads.

Olympiad.title: The Francophone Mathematical Olympiad
Olympiad.lead: A competition of excellence for young mathematicians of the French-speaking world, led by the Terangamath association and an international scientific committee.

Presentation.title: A competition of excellence, a spirit of hospitality
Presentation.body1: Each year, OFM brings together the best middle and high school students from French-speaking countries around original mathematics exams, designed to reveal reasoning as much as technique.
Presentation.body2: The 2027 edition is organised in Dakar by Terangamath, a Senegalese association dedicated to promoting mathematics, with the ambition of combining scientific rigour with Senegalese hospitality — the Teranga.

Format.title: The exam format
Format.lead: Two categories, several days of exams, marked by an international jury. The precise format will be published with the final programme.

Organisation.title: Terangamath & the organisation of OFM 2027
Organisation.lead: The Olympiad is led by the Terangamath association, supported by committees dedicated to logistics and to the scientific design of the exams.

About.title: The organising association
About.body: Terangamath is the Senegalese association behind OFM 2027. Its name draws on the Teranga, Senegalese hospitality, which it puts to work promoting mathematics among young people across the French-speaking world.

Teams.lead: French-speaking countries are progressively confirming their participation. Each delegation brings together competitors in the Junior and Senior categories.
